summary: Iteration 7: validated the newly-activated engine stack (deployments, paper, alerts, copy) end-to-end + full UI regression + Swift Fi rebranding check. 44/44 backend pytest pass (11 engine + 17 email-auth-wallets + 16 relay). All engine phases exercised live: create paper deployment with always-true trigger (ETH>1) -> within ~35s engine opened a paper ETH long at the REAL mainnet price ($2,421.45, 2x) and the fill event ("paper long ETH $50 @ 2421.45 (2x)") was visible in deployment-{id} card AND paper-positions section. Pause/Resume/Stop controls on the UI all fire the correct engine state transition (verified by refreshed event log + status badge: active -> paused -> active -> stopped). Alerts-mode happy path verified by test_engine.py::test_alerts_mode_creates_alert (90s wait path passes). Copy modal happy path exercised live: autocopy-trader-* opens copy-modal; copy-mode-paper + copy-start-btn created a copy deployment and modal closed cleanly. Live-mode-on-unfunded path: covered by test_live_mode_requires_email_account_note which polls the deployment event log for a non-500 error event (passes, no engine loop crash). Branding: zero visible Weft/WEFT in frontend chrome (title, header, buttons, labels); the only remaining 'Weft' sightings are (1) internal identifiers (api module name `weft`, localStorage key `weft:session`, data-testid tokens) — none user-visible — and (2) one upstream-seeded strategy card titled 'Buy WEFT at $1.6m' which is user-provided data from the Railway relay, not frontend branding. All 7 pages render (Home, New, Strategies, Traders, Leaderboard, Revenue, Account); header shows SwiftFi. logo + Strategies/Traders/Leaderboard/Revenue + Account/Start trading. Found one tiny grammar bug and the previously-noted dev-only hydration warning.

minor.issue: Event log and UI toast say 'deployment stopd by user' / toast 'Deployment stopd' when action=stop. The format string in server.py:622 (`f"deployment {action}d by user"`) and Account.jsx:224 (`\`Deployment ${action}d\``) assume English past tense is action+'d', which produces 'paused' ✓, 'resumed' ✓, but 'stopd' ✗. Map action -> past-tense verb explicitly (pause->paused, resume->resumed, stop->stopped).

issues: Repeat of prior-iteration dev-only React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by the x-component dev-overlay wrapping option text; harmless in production build. Noisy in dev console only. No functional impact.

action_items: Low priority: fix 'stopd' typo in /app/backend/server.py line 622 and /app/frontend/src/pages/Account.jsx line 224 — switch the ad-hoc `${action}d` string to an explicit map {pause:'paused', resume:'resumed', stop:'stopped'}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 622 and Account.jsx line 224 — ad-hoc `${action}+d` past-tense generation. Works for 2/3 verbs by coincidence. Use an explicit mapping to avoid future verbs breaking it.

engine.py tick interval is a hard-coded 25s (ENGINE_TICK = 25). Fine for MVP but no backoff on upstream (Hyperliquid price fetch) failure — if the API is slow, ticks pile up. Consider aiohttp timeouts (already present) + per-deployment skip-this-tick on error (already present via try/except in _tick_deployment). OK as-is.

Copy-mode deployments created with sizeUsd default of $100 are fine, but there's no validation on the server side that sizeUsd is positive — a client sending sizeUsd=-100 or 0 would still create a deployment that then produces errors on open. Add Pydantic/manual guard (sizeUsd > 0).

Account.jsx DeploymentsPanel polls GET /api/deployments every 10s unconditionally. Fine today but with many deployments this grows the response payload (events capped? engine._event trims to last 50 — good). No action needed.

The engine stores paper positions in-memory inside PaperAccount (Mongo-backed) — verified persists across engine restarts because paper account is read back via get_paper_account on each request. Good.

Alerts-mode cooldown relies on trigger.cooldownMinutes to avoid alert spam — if a user sets cooldownMinutes=0, every tick (25s) would create a new alert row. Clamp to a minimum (e.g. max(cooldown, 1 minute)) to be safe.
Live-mode with an unfunded custodial wallet correctly logs a non-500 error event (verified by passing test_live_mode_requires_email_account_note). Engine loop proven to not crash on this path.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical issue this iteration. Minor 'stopd' typo RCA: server.py:622 builds the event message as `f"deployment {action}d by user"` where action is directly the user-provided control verb ('pause'|'resume'|'stop'). Past-tense is coincidentally correct for 'pause' (paused) and 'resume' (resumed) because they both end in -e, but 'stop' + 'd' = 'stopd' (not 'stopped'). Same bug duplicated in Account.jsx line 224 toast. Fix: `const PAST = {pause:'paused', resume:'resumed', stop:'stopped'}; const past = PAST[action] || action; ...f"deployment {past} by user"`.
